# package npcap

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/l2/npcap"
```

Package npcap is the Windows backend of l2.Port, on the Npcap driver ([https://npcap.com](https://npcap.com)), which must be installed separately (its licence does not allow redistributing it). The package loads wpcap.dll at run time; no cgo is needed.

Npcap is free for personal use on up to five systems; commercial use and redistribution need an Npcap OEM licence. Install it with "WinPcap API- compatible mode" or add %SystemRoot%\\System32\\Npcap to the DLL search path.

## Functions

### func Available

```go
func Available() error
```

Available reports whether wpcap.dll can be loaded.
